elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 16 and 17 apply to a contract only to the extent that it relates to the transfer of the ownership or possession of goods from one person to another, whether or not work has been done on them.
elements.quote: relates to the transfer of the ownership or possession of goods from one person to another (with or without work having been done on them)

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 16 and 17 apply to a contract only to the extent that it constitutes a contract of service or apprenticeship.
elements.quote: constitutes a contract of service or apprenticeship

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 16 and 17 apply to a contract only to the extent that it relates to services of whatever kind, including carriage, deposit and pledge, care and custody, mandate, agency, loan, and services relating to the use of land.
elements.quote: relates to services of whatever kind, including (without prejudice to the foregoing generality) carriage, deposit and pledge, care and custody, mandate, agency, loan and services relating to the use of land

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 16 and 17 apply to a contract only to the extent that it relates to the liability of an occupier of land to persons entering upon or using that land.

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 16 and 17 apply to a contract only to the extent that it relates to a grant of any right or permission to enter upon or use land that does not amount to an estate or interest in the land.

elements.requirement: Notwithstanding subsection (2), sections 16 and 17 do not apply to any contract to the extent that it is a contract of insurance, including a contract to pay an annuity on human life.

elements.requirement: Notwithstanding subsection (2), sections 16 and 17 do not apply to any contract to the extent that it relates to the formation, constitution, or dissolution of any body corporate, unincorporated association, or partnership.
